tree.name: BOM Testprojekt
tree.description: Editable demo Project (proto Demo). Pure Template is Datentypen+Praefixe+SI units only; this copy adds Bauart, electronics units, Compositionen, Bauteile. See docs/plans/data-structure.md and prototypes/tree-split.

children.name: Typen
children.description: Type branch (Q26): Datentypen, Praefixe, Basiseinheit only.

children.name: Datentypen
children.description: Simple (scalars + node_ref) and Complex (quantity, subtree, Collection).

children.name: int
children.description: Whole number.

children.name: double
children.description: Floating point.

children.name: text
children.description: Single-line text.

children.name: textarea
children.description: Multi-line text.

children.name: char
children.description: Single character.

children.name: bool
children.description: Boolean.

children.name: display_node_name
children.description: Read-only: shows the host Node.name (no user input).

children.name: media
children.description: WP Media Library and/or URL (Q65). MIME-based display.

children.name: node_ref
children.description: Free jump to any Node (no ref_scope).

children.name: quantity
children.description: Groesse: value + optional prefix + base unit (not a measurement act).

children.name: subtree
children.description: Pick under a catalog root via Relation ref_scope.

children.name: Abmessung
children.description: Package dimensions L/B/H. Each edge is a Meter quantity (Typ + Praefix + m). Table: one Abmessung column containing L/B/H.

children.name: L
children.description: Length as Meter quantity (Typ + Praefix + m).

children.name: B
children.description: Width (Breite) as Meter quantity.

children.name: H
children.description: Height (Hoehe) as Meter quantity.

children.name: Collection
children.description: Super-kind list/table/enum/set. Property Projektname (type text) lives on Collection instances - not a tree child (Q61; Q64 superseded).

children.name: list
children.description: Collection with exactly one column; rows open.

children.name: RefDes
children.description: BOM open list for board references (R1, R2, ...).

children.name: Element
children.description: Single list column - has_type text (proto).

children.name: table
children.description: Collection with n columns; rows open. Extra settings: has footer (Fusszeile). BOM/Rezept -> table.

children.name: enum
children.description: Like list + closed options under the column.

children.name: Bauart
children.description: Concrete enum for footprints (BOM Testprojekt, not pure Template).

children.name: Option
children.description: Single enum column - has_type text (proto).

children.name: set
children.description: Collection of named members; schema = child nodes (each typed). Used by Bauteil groups.

children.name: Praefixe
children.description: SI prefixes. multiplikator = scale vs the unit’s prefix root (Q51). Same factors for Meter and mass — mass differs via unit prefix_root_to_si (g→kg).

children.name: p
children.description: SI prefix pico (10⁻¹²).

children.name: n
children.description: SI prefix nano (10⁻⁹).

children.name: u
children.description: SI prefix micro (10⁻⁶); proto: µ.

children.name: m
children.description: SI prefix milli (10⁻³); with Meter symbol → mm (Millimeter).

children.name: c
children.description: SI prefix centi (10⁻²).

children.name: k
children.description: SI prefix kilo (10³).

children.name: Mega
children.description: SI prefix mega (10⁶); node name Mega avoids slug clash with milli m.

children.name: Basiseinheit
children.description: Each unit is a set: Typ (numeric type) + optional Praefix + Kuerzel. Display = Praefix+Kuerzel. to_si = Typ × multiplikator × prefix_root_to_si. Mass: SI base = kg, prefix root = g.

children.name: Meter
children.description: Length; m+m → mm.

children.name: Typ
children.description: Numeric magnitude field; data type = double.

children.name: Praefix
children.description: Optional SI prefix from Praefixe (e.g. catalog “m” = Milli). Not fixed in the unit schema. Display: Praefix + Kuerzel → mm.

children.name: Kuerzel
children.description: Fixed unit symbol / prefix-root (e.g. Meter → m). Not the Praefix catalog node “m” (Milli). With Praefix → mm / kΩ / mg.
